newsitem.title: INDIA: India Ranbaxy to discuss Croslands deal.
newsitem.headline: India Ranbaxy to discuss Croslands deal.

text.p: The board of India's Ranbaxy Laboratories Ltd is scheduled to meet at 3.30 p.m. (1000 GMT) on Monday to consider a proposed merger with Croslands Laboratories Ltd, a Ranbaxy spokeswoman said.
"It is to discuss the Croslands merger," the spokeswoman for the pharmaceutical giant told Reuters by telephone.
The spokeswoman said an announcement on any decision taken at the board meeting was not likely on Monday. She added that Croslands was expected to hold a news conference at Bombay on Tuesday.
Financial Express said on Monday that the merger, expected to bring Croslands within Ranbaxy's fold, was likely to involve a share swap of one Ranbaxy share for 2.5 to three shares of Croslands.
The merger would help Croslands, which has a strong presence in the dermatology sector, through Ranbaxy's distribution network, the newspaper said.

On the country's premier Bombay stock exchange, Croslands shares were trading at 254.0 rupees, 5.83 percent above Friday's closing price of 240.0, following news of the proposed merger with Ranbaxy, dealers said.
Ranbaxy's shares were trading at 606.75 rupees, up from 596.25 rupees at close on Friday.
Newspapers had earlier speculated on a proposed merger of Croslands with Nicholas Piramal, one of Ranbaxy's rivals in the Indian pharmaceutical market.
